question.prompt: An exterior angle of a triangle measures \(120^\circ\). The ratio of the two interior angles that are not adjacent to it is \(1:3\). Find the measure of the larger of these interior angles in degrees.

solutions.explanation: The sum of the two interior angles is \(120^\circ\). The larger angle is \(120^\circ\times3\div4=90^\circ\).
solutions.title: Divide the exterior-angle total in the given ratio
